_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear & Greed at 54 and dead ETF flows keep price in a drift coil; outflows help the bid but no breaker has fired to exit Complacency yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION in Complacency; narrative supplies bullish outflow color without a phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-54, BTC remains range-bound, ETF flows stay dead, no dvol/CVD distribution
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks below 46 on rising dvol with CVD/netflow distribution, or ETF flows revive and Fear & Greed pushes through 62
